name: Itihakala Restaurant
area: Hagare-Itihakala Road, about 1 km from Hoysaleswara Temple, Halebidu
why_it_matters: The highest-rated eatery in Halebidu on Tripadvisor — a traditional-style open-plan pure-veg restaurant about a kilometre from the Hoysaleswara Temple, serving an unlimited Karnataka thali on banana leaf with holige (sweet flatbread) and dry sabji. The standout meal in a small temple village otherwise short on dining.
insider_tip: Worth the short hop from the temple — the unlimited banana-leaf thali at around ₹200 is the order, eaten in the traditional open-plan dining room. Pure-veg and home-style. Cash and UPI.
signature_address: Itihakala Restaurant, Hagare-Itihakala Road, near Hoysaleswara Temple, Halebidu, Hassan District, Karnataka 573121

name: Mang Tree Veg Restaurant
why_it_matters: A pure-veg restaurant barely 200 metres from the Hoysaleswara Temple — the closest proper meal to the monument. Reviewers praise its home-style Karnataka cooking, clean and not-oily, in a setting with a heritage feel, making it the convenient post-darshan stop in Halebidu.
insider_tip: The nearest sit-down restaurant to the temple, so handy straight after the visit. Service is quick but not every menu item is always available — ask what is being made fresh. Cash and UPI.
signature_address: Mang Tree Veg Restaurant, near Hoysaleswara Temple, Halebidu, Hassan District, Karnataka 573121

name: KSTDC Hotel Mayura Shantala Restaurant
why_it_matters: The restaurant of the government-run KSTDC Hotel Mayura Shantala, located almost next door to the Hoysaleswara Temple — the most convenient government-run dining in Halebidu, serving Karnataka local flavours and standard South Indian fare.
insider_tip: The location, right by the temple, is the main reason to come; reviewers note the food is basic, so keep it simple with the veg meals or tiffin. Cards, UPI and cash.
signature_address: KSTDC Hotel Mayura Shantala, opposite Hoysaleswara Temple, Halebidu, Hassan District, Karnataka 573121

name: Kokum — Hoysala Village Resort (Hassan base, 16 km)
area: Belur Road, Hassan — base town for the Hoysala pair
signature_dish: Malnad cuisine buffet on banana leaf
why_it_matters: Kokum, the restaurant at Hoysala Village Resort on the Belur Road near Hassan — listed here as a Hassan-base option because Halebidu itself is a tiny temple village with little dining, and most visitors do Belur and Halebidu from a Hassan base about 16 km away. The Malnad-cuisine breakfast buffet, served on banana leaf with akki roti, holige and jalebi at live counters, is the standout.
insider_tip: This is in Hassan, roughly 16 km from Halebidu — useful if you are basing the Hoysala temple pair from Hassan town. The Malnad breakfast buffet is the highlight; reviewers say skip the pricey lunch buffet and order a-la-carte. Cards, UPI and cash.
signature_address: Kokum, Hoysala Village Resort, Belur Road, Hassan, Hassan District, Karnataka 573201
